result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the cap is mutual, applies agreement-wide, equals the greater of paid or payable 12-month fees and USD 1,000,000, excludes indirect and consequential damages mutually, and includes all required uncapped carve-outs. Client payment obligations are also expressly outside the limitation. The existing indemnity is preserved unchanged, and the additions are limited to implementing the playbook. Drafting is professional, though the fee lookback should ideally be expressly anchored to the claim and phrased as the “12-month period preceding the claim” to avoid ambiguity.
